name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: ECMWF wet-bulb-zero Snowline proxy to +144 h with built-in place search, saved favourites, clear-search control, hide/show panel control, persistent search-result labels, reliable Windy singleclick point selection for mobile, Label only, Contour only, and Label + contour modes, desktop Windy picker following, concise point labels, ±100 m near-snowline wording, 3-hour snowline tendency, higher adaptive contour sampling by zoom, queued viewport refreshes, Windy map elevation, caching and decluttered contours. Thermal snowline only; precipitation is not implied.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
